identificationModule.briefTitle: Amrubicin (AMR) Trial in Patients With Non-small Cell Lung Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomised, Open-Label Phase 3 Trial Comparing Amrubicin Versus Docetaxel in Patients With Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer After Failure of First-Line Chemotherapy

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The study is to evaluate the effect of amrubicin (AMR) compared to docetaxel (DOC) in the treatment of non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC).

interventions.name: Amrubicin hydrocloride
interventions.description: AMR was administered i.v. by 35mg/m2 at day 1, 2 and 3 followed by 3 week rest as 1 course.

interventions.name: Docetaxel
interventions.description: DOC was administered i.v. by 60mg/m2 at day 1 followed by 3 week rest as 1 course.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Number of Participants with Adverse Events

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Histological or cytological diagnosis of non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC)
* 1 or 2 prior chemotherapy regimen including 1 platinum-based chemotherapy
* 20 or older but younger than 75 years of age

Exclusion Criteria:

* Symptomatic brain metastasis
* Interstitial pneumonia or pulmonary fibrosis
* Abnormal cardiac function or myocardial infraction within 6 months before study enrollment
* Active infection
